Regenerate with `app-graph.py --write` (regex) or `--index-store PATH --write` (fleet Debug build); never hand-edit. groups: destination, host_members (Type.member the group reaches through its Host), deps, cuts (reason app = into the composition root, upward = up the layer order or into a higher tier, cycle = would close a package cycle), scc_id (component of the uncut graph, root edges aside), order (index into `order`; the composition root has the last index). order: move units leaf-first, one seam commit plus one move commit each. destinations: final dependency list per target.
